sections.heading: 2. Data we process
sections.body: When you request a quote we collect your name, email address, phone number, project address, preferred call time slot and the technical details of the project (renovation type, floor area and quality level). If you use the contact form we collect your name, email address and message. We also process browsing data if you accept measurement cookies.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose and legal basis
sections.body: We process your data to prepare and send you the requested quote, to contact you within the time slot you select and to answer your enquiries. The legal basis is the application of pre-contractual measures at your request, together with your consent. Browsing and advertising data are processed solely on the basis of your explicit consent.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies and measurement
sections.body: We use Google Analytics 4 and Google Ads to analyse site usage and measure the performance of our campaigns. These technologies are only activated if you accept cookies in the corresponding notice. You may reject them and continue using the site normally, or change your decision by clearing your browser cookies.

sections.heading: 5. Recipients
sections.body: Your data is hosted on Google Firebase (Google Cloud). If you accept measurement cookies, Google LLC acts as a recipient of browsing data. These international transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. We do not sell or transfer your data to third parties for commercial purposes.

sections.heading: 6. Retention period
sections.body: We keep your request data for as long as necessary to handle it and, thereafter, for the statutory limitation periods. You may request its deletion at any time.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability by writing to [PENDIENTE: completar con los datos fiscales de la empresa]. You may also withdraw your consent at any time and lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: These terms govern access to and use of the Refcon website, a construction and renovation company operating in Mallorca.

sections.heading: 2. Quotes are indicative
sections.body: The estimate generated by the website calculator is indicative and NOT contractually binding. It is derived from average prices per square metre and does not account for the specific conditions of each property. A binding quote is always issued in writing following a technical site visit.

sections.heading: 3. Use of the site
sections.body: You agree to use the site in accordance with the law and to provide truthful information in the forms. Using the forms for purposes other than requesting services is not permitted.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual property
sections.body: The content, trademarks, images and videos on this site belong to Refcon or are used under the relevant licence. Reproduction without prior written consent is not authorised.

sections.heading: 5. Liability
sections.body: Refcon is not liable for service interruptions beyond its control, nor for decisions taken solely on the basis of the indicative estimate provided by the website.

sections.heading: 6. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. Any dispute shall be subject to the courts designated under consumer protection legislation.
